outcome: predictive value of fetal DV Doppler for NEC in fetal growth restriction fetuses (FGRF)
predictive accuracy of IG21 and Fenton curves in NEC development
finding: Fetal Doppler findings, particularly absent or reversed end-diastolic flow (AREDF), increased resistance in the DV, and a lower Fenton z-score, were effective in predicting NEC in FGR.
birth_weight: median birth weight not different between groups
